title: Keep restart recovery after repeated rejection through remaining generic queue drains
outcome: A restart recovery requeued after an initial synchronous rejection is retained when a later activation through an unconverted generic queue drain is synchronously rejected again. Remaining sites: federation_mailbox_wake_worker.rs:159, session_crud.rs:849/:1289, delegations.rs:2620, orchestrator_lifecycle.rs:640 and test_run_waits.rs:1194. Scope is recovery identity only; ordinary prompts and accepted/ambiguous deliveries retain their current behavior.
acceptance: The listed owner-less generic drains retain selected queued identity and route delivery through the existing recovery-aware shared owner, or the documented supported surface is deliberately narrowed with explicit disposition of the unsupported paths.

A regression drives an initial recovery rejection, then a listed generic activation whose send is rejected again, and persists/reboots to prove the recovery is not consumed while its no-replay marker remains set.
